description: This Java source file defines the class MetadataFromSignal, which creates and modifies Metadata objects based on Signal headers and existing Metadata. It provides methods to construct Metadata instances from signals, with the core logic for building metadata from headers and entity properties.

classes.name: MetadataFromSignal
classes.description: A final class that implements Supplier<Metadata> to create or extend Metadata objects based on a Signal's headers and existing Metadata. It manages constructing new Metadata or modifying existing Metadata by processing metadata headers from Signal that are associated with entity entities.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new instance of MetadataFromSignal with provided signal, optional entity handler, and existing metadata.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Builds and returns Metadata based on the Signal's headers and optional existing Metadata. Returns null if conditions for creating Metadata are not met.

methods.name: getMetadataHeadersToPut
methods.description: Retrieves the set of MetadataHeaders that are to be added or updated, from the Signal's DittoHeaders.

methods.name: buildMetadata
methods.description: Constructs a Metadata object by processing the entity JsonValue and a set of MetadataHeaders, adding relevant entries to the MetadataBuilder.

methods.name: getMetadataBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new MetadataBuilder, initialized with existingMetadata if present.

methods.name: addMetadataToLeaf
methods.description: Recursively adds Metadata entries to the MetadataBuilder based on the entity JSON structure and MetadataHeader, only for non-special and non-hidden fields.
